kultivator.formasi.spec.awan_transfer.de: A pair of transfer nodes between the ground and the sect's sky island. One node stands in the sky hall's territory (built by the Cloud Core at tier 1); you lay the other one yourself on the ground, at most 128 blocks from the stele horizontally, at any height. Sneak-use the formation eye with an empty hand to open the node map: a 3 second channel (1.5 with a keeper), 10 qi from the traveller, 1 Daya from the source node (free with a keeper), a 10 second cooldown. Up to 4 following disciples come along. At most 2 cloud nodes per sect.
kultivator.formasi.spec.awan_transfer.hi: A 3×3 ring of smooth quartz around the formation eye and an amethyst block on each diagonal corner (2 blocks from the eye). Ground node: within 128 blocks horizontally of the sky hall's stele.
kultivator.formasi.spec.awan_transfer.so: Huainanzi (quoted in Religions 14(11):1366, "Searching for the Location of Lord Lao"): the three-tiered Kunlun, from Liangfeng below up to the upper heaven, climbed tier by tier; Kunlun is also named a pillar joining earth and heaven (Wikipedia "Eight Pillars"). The node pair, the 128 block reach and the costs are game design.
kultivator.formasi.spec.jaring_awan.name: Cloud Net Formation
kultivator.formasi.spec.jaring_awan.desc: A net of cloud strung between the four Net Poles on the sky island's rim (tier 5). The sect's base net always catches falling members; while this formation runs it also catches invited guests and allied visitors, and members may take the Cloud Dive: step or jump off the island's rim, then hold sneak (within 2 seconds) to glide gently down to the ground unhurt. Attackers are never caught. Upkeep 6 Daya an hour (a quarter while the island is empty); a disciple can keep it.
kultivator.formasi.spec.jaring_awan.hint: On the sky island's formation disc: a 3×3 ring of smooth quartz around the eye, an amethyst block under the eye, four quartz pillar ×2 posts crowned with amethyst 3 blocks from the eye on each side, and an end rod on each diagonal corner 2 blocks from the eye. The four Net Poles on the island's rim must still stand.
kultivator.formasi.spec.jaring_awan.sour: Liezi, "Tang Wen" (Wikipedia "Guixu", "Ao (turtle)"): the Emperor of Heaven had Yuqiang send fifteen giant turtles to hold up the five floating mountains of Guixu in turns so they would not drift away. The cloud net, the poles and the rules are game design.
